evidence: With the newly synthesized (N-iPr-AMD)3Ce as the Ce precursor and O3 as the oxygen source, CeOx was deposited on SiO2(100 nm)/Si substrates in an MNTf-150-212 flow-type ALD reactor (Jiangsu MNT Micro and Nanotech Co., LTD., Wuxi, China). High-purity N2 (99.999%) was used as the carrier and purge gas with a gas flow of 20 sccm.
